verdict.rationale: Mem0's documented operations (add, search, list, update, delete) appear to operate on individual memories, and the CLI/API descriptions never mention batch create/update/delete across many items in a single call. The Memory Export feature (mem0-docs-12/32) is the closest hint of a multi-item operation but is scoped to exporting, not general bulk manipulation, so it doesn't establish a bulk-operations capability.
